_provenance: schema-derived: named constants required by O6 spec, citing López de Prado 2018 Ch. 7.4
_citation: López de Prado, M. (2018). Advances in Financial Machine Learning. Wiley. Ch. 7.4 (Nested cross-validation / frozen evaluation window).

required_constants.name: TRAIN_RATIO
required_constants._rationale: 60% of history for hyperparameter optimization training fold

required_constants.name: VALIDATION_RATIO
required_constants._rationale: 20% of history for trial selection (Optuna objective scoring fold)

required_constants.name: FROZEN_EVAL_RATIO
required_constants._rationale: 20% of history for honest post-selection performance reporting; never consumed during Optuna trial sweep

partition_ordering._note: Temporal ordering preserved: chronologically earliest dates in train, latest in frozen-eval
